test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: Udai walks 25 m towards the west, and then he turns left and walks 55 m. Then, he takes a right turn and walks 45 m. Then, he turns right again and walks 70 m. In which direction and what distance should he walk now to reach 15 m north of the starting point?
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: Udai walks 25 m towards the west, and then he turns left and walks 55 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97b9808d67ae04fccd4db0ccc9935e65a1de81d5789cb54c7a6936d5d8c50030.png] 

Step 2: Then, he takes a right turn and walks 45 m. Then, he turns right again and walks 70 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/629469f57788137638fc446303b1c865c11afbdee4ea15d151ceec0b5563931e.png] 

Now we have to find out the direction and distance he should walk now to reach 15 m north of the starting point,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eebf6d0de5efc4b54ae80e9c2a98435994e1ab10ef6a19e42f360155885d2cac.png] Total distance from end point = 25 + 45 = 70 m

From the figure it is clear that **he should walk 70 m towards east.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**
